meta.method: Read-only HCI queries over HCI_CHANNEL_RAW (python socket, allowlisted READ opcodes only, bt_probe.py), cross-checked with btmon 5.77 and Wireshark/tshark 4.7.0 decode of the same capture (raw/probe.btsnoop); btmgmt (run under a pty), bluetoothctl, sysfs, debugfs (read only), rotated syslog.
commands_sent_per_controller: LE Read Advertising Physical Channel TX Power
LE Read Filter Accept List Size
LE Read Maximum Advertising Data Length
LE Read Number of Supported Advertising Sets

le_transmitter_test.caveat: Support is read from the Supported Commands bitmap; no test command was executed (transmission forbidden). btmon 5.77 and Wireshark do not expand octets 44-45, so the v4 bit position is from the Core spec table, not tool-verified; octets 44 and 45 are 0xff so v4 reads as supported at any bit in those two octets.

kernel_user_channel.boot_config_6.11.9_BT: CONFIG_BT=m, CONFIG_BT_HCIBTUSB=m, CONFIG_BT_INTEL=m, CONFIG_BT_LE=y (different kernel, informational only)
kernel_user_channel.up_evidence: btmgmt current settings include 'powered' on all 8; raw-channel HCI commands completed on all 8 (would fail with ENETDOWN if down)
